title: Mock2 blocked-deviation resolution payload (blockingSummary output)
description: PATCH B.1/B.4. The admin-visible resolution payload for a blocked-deviation cycle: the CLASS-MATCHED options (every finding class present is offered at least one option that resolves it) and, when the loop breaker fires, the resolution-ineffective state with the full finding list inline. Derived from the stored integration-gate result; not persisted separately.

state.description: resolution-ineffective when the same finding set has survived N=2 consecutive resolutions (B.4)

signature.description: order-independent signature of the finding set (loop-breaker comparison key)

findings.description: the finding list; surfaced INLINE (not a count) when resolution-ineffective

options.description: class-matched resolution options; suppressed to a single record-resolution affordance when resolution-ineffective

resolves.description: the finding classes this option can transition to resolved (empty for the record_resolution escape hatch)

requires_resolution.description: present when resolution-ineffective: a free-text or admin resolution is required before another automatic resume

uncovered.description: finding classes present with NO resolving option — a harness defect (must be empty; the B.1 invariant test fails otherwise)
